content: अतिग {%a.%} [गम्-ड] (in <ab>comp.</ab>) Exceeding, going beyond, transcending, excelling, surpassing; सर्वलोक˚ <ls>Mu. 1. 2</ls>; किमौषधपथातिगैरुपहतो महाव्याधिभिः <ls>Mu. 6. 16</ls> by diseases defying the powers of medicine, past the stage of physicking; बाणैर्देहातिगैः <ls>R. 12. 48</ls> piercing through their bodies; वयो˚ <ls>Ms. 7. 149</ls> advanced in years, aged; संख्यातिगाः संपदः <ls>Bh. 3. 132</ls>; वपुःप्रकर्षेण जनातिगेन <ls>Ki. 3. 2</ls>.
